title: Wave The Wheat Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Wave The Wheat is a 3 BR / 3 BA / 8 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. Marked by high-end luxuries, set amidst a beach setting, Wave The Wheat delights with casual sophistication; a true beach cottage that lives up to its reputation.
description_expanded: Description2102 East County Highway 30A3 KINGS, BONUS BUNKROOM- sleeps 8Luxury Gulfside Living Just Steps from the SandWave the Wheat is a high-end beachside retreat offering one of the most coveted locations in Seaside, Florida—just 92 feet from private beach access and only a three-minute walk to downtown Seaside and Central Square, home to more than 35 shops and restaurants. Designed for effortless coastal living, this elegant cottage features two levels of covered outdoor spaces, perfect for dining al fresco while enjoying the sound of Gulf waves just beyond your doorstep.Floor-to-ceiling windows and expansive glass doors blur the line between indoor and outdoor living, flooding the home with natural light and showcasing stunning coastal views throughout.First-Floor Guest Suites with Private Outdoor AccessThe first level welcomes guests with two spacious king bedrooms, each offering renovated private ensuite baths and direct access to outdoor patios. The first king bedroom features a large mounted flat-screen TV, ample storage, and a spa-inspired ensuite bath with a single vanity and a glass-enclosed tub/shower combination with a rain shower head.The second king bedroom is ideal for families, featuring an adjoining room with custom built-in bunk beds and a large mounted flat-screen TV, creating the perfect space for children. The renovated ensuite bath is finished with floor-to-ceiling marble, a glass-enclosed walk-in shower, and a single vanity, delivering a true spa-like experience. Both bedrooms open to private outdoor patios, enhancing the home’s seamless indoor-outdoor flow.A thoughtfully designed foyer entry connects the bedrooms and includes custom built-in storage and a seating bench, ideal for beach gear and easy transitions after a day in the sand.Elevated Second-Floor Living & Entertaining SpacesIn a unique and intentional layout, the second floor serves as the home’s main living area, maximizing views and light. The renovated open kitchen features high-end Viking stainless steel appliances, custom cabinetry, and sleek contemporary finishes. Bar seating for two complements the space, while surrounding windows provide gulf glimpses and unforgettable sunset views.The adjacent dining area includes a table and bench seating for six, flowing effortlessly into the stylish living room. Furnished with two large sofas, two club chairs, and a mounted flat-screen TV, this space is ideal for relaxing evenings after long beach days. Expansive windows open directly onto the second-floor deck, further enhancing the coastal ambiance.Private Primary Suite with Gulf ViewsThe third king bedroom, located on the second level, serves as the private primary suite. This serene retreat features a mounted flat-screen TV, balcony access, and gulf views, along with a beautifully renovated ensuite bath complete with a single vanity and a large glass-enclosed walk-in shower—offering comfort and privacy in equal measure.Show-Stopping Gulf-View BalconyThe crown jewel of Wave the Wheat is the expansive second-floor covered balcony, designed for unforgettable outdoor living. This space features bar-top dining for four, two double chaise loungers, two club chairs, and additional gulf-front seating for two, all positioned to capture breathtaking sunset and water views. Just 92 feet from the shoreline, this balcony invites you to dine, lounge, and unwind to the rhythm of the waves.With accommodations for up to eight guests, exceptional finishes, and an unbeatable location steps from the beach and town center, Wave the Wheat delivers a refined Seaside experience defined by luxury, comfort, and coastal elegance.* 5 Night Minimum Remaining Nights Summer 2026. Sat to Sat 7-night minimum Summer, 5-night minimum in Spring & Spring Break, 3-night minimum for Fall, 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURES1,655 square feet of beautifully designed coastal living spaceIncredible 1-minute (151-foot) walk to Pensacola Pavilion, the largest stretch of private residential beaches on 30APrivate off-street driveway with parking for two vehiclesThree king bedrooms, each with a private ensuite bathPlasma televisions and DVD playersHigh-end appliances throughout the homeWasher and dryer for guest conveniencePeacock Alley Linens – fresh, luxurious sheets and towels throughout the homeFull access to Seaside amenities, including three swimming pools, five clay tennis courts, three pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedParking policy: Golf carts are considered vehicles; golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002239
